OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSTNESS IMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  2023 MINUTES OF THE ANNUAL MEETING
  Monday, March 13,2023

1.  WELCOME AI\D CALL TO ORDER

  Chairman Craig Walters welcomed attendees. The following board members were
  present: Craig Walters, Micky Rehm, Zuhey Espinoza, and George Henderson. Not
  Present: Marianne Stark.

2.  CALENDAR

  Cool Cruise Car Show - Saturdayo April 8,2023 - 10am-4pm
  Heart of the Foothills - Sunday, April 23,2023 - 9am-4pm
  Wine Walk - Saturday, April 29,2023 - 5pm-8:30pm
  Beer Walk - Saturday, September 23,2023 - 5pm-8:30pm

3.  PRESENTATIONS

  Gold Line Update

  Lisa Levy Buch of the Gold Line Construction Authority presented a construction
  update.

  Nlayor's City Update

  Mayor Tim Hepburn introduced City Staffand University of La Verne President Dr.
  Devorah Lieberman. Mayor Hepburn provided updates for each department, staffing, and
  introduced the newest Cify Council members.

  University of La Verne Update

  Dr. Devorah Lieberman introduced the Leadership Team, provided an update on
  University events, and discussed the partnership between the University and the City

  OId Town District & Association Report

  Chairman Craig Walters discussed upcoming events such as the Wine Walk on April
  29th.He also discussed the recent update at Mainiero Square and announced plans for live
  entertainment during the summer.
 4.  PUBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by Califomia Brown Act Law)

  None

5.  ADJOURNMENT

  Meeting was adjourned at 9:16 a.m., the next regular meeting to be held on Monday,
  April 3, 2023 at 8:30 a.m. at Cafd Wang Restaurant.
